origin.comment: The direction and exact rules below were generated after manual inspection of every pre-2021 mother signal's plus/minus 126-session chart. This is consumed development research, not independent confirmation.

economic_mechanism: A laggard's first active-demand day is useful only when it occurs inside broad, non-exhausted leader-to-follower demand diffusion and is accepted for two completed sessions. Isolated or mature-cycle rebounds and already-extended pseudo-laggards are excluded.

frozen_rules.name: MOTHER_EVENT_UNCHANGED
frozen_rules.definition: Reuse the exact frozen prior-session industry-laggard plus first active-demand mother population without rebuilding, rethresholding, or adding a breakout condition.

frozen_rules.name: CAUSAL_MARKET_DIFFUSION_LIFECYCLE
frozen_rules.definition: At the mother signal close: market_regime == BULL; same-date mother-event count >= 6; and (market_median_ret20 >= 0.03 or market_median_ret20 >= market_median_ret60). Reject mature exhaustion when market_median_ret60 >= 0.20 and market_median_ret20 <= 0.10.
frozen_rules.comment: Same-date count is known after the signal close and is used as contemporaneous breadth, not as a future outcome. It is interpreted jointly with causal market lifecycle rather than as a standalone crowding rule.

frozen_rules.name: ABSOLUTE_NON_CHASER
frozen_rules.comment: Being a relative industry laggard is insufficient when the stock itself has already risen at least 20 percent over the completed prior 20 sessions.

frozen_rules.name: TWO_SESSION_PRICE_ACCEPTANCE
frozen_rules.definition: The next two consecutive exchange sessions must each be valid, tradable, hard-valid, corporate-action-safe, on the same coordinate lineage, and have coordinate close >= the mother signal coordinate close.
frozen_rules.decision_time: after the second acceptance session close
frozen_rules.comment: The two sessions are predictors only because entry is delayed until a later legal session; neither bar may be filled inside.

frozen_rules.name: CONFIRMED_BULL_AND_DELAYED_EXECUTION
frozen_rules.definition: The causal market state must still be BULL at the second acceptance close. Enter at the first legal non-limit-up open in confirmation+1 through confirmation+3; exit at a 15 percent coordinate-price target or the first legal open after 30 held sessions; charge 20 bps per side.

execution_contract.corporate_action_handling: same invalid_step_cum lineage plus accepted corporate-action validity; fail closed
